name: arch-diagram
description: Draw readable architecture diagrams (system / stack / infra / cloud / service topology — 아키텍처 · 시스템 구성도 · 기술 스택 · 인프라 구성도) from a typed JSON spec as self-contained interactive HTML (light + dark, focus / upstream-downstream / route deep links), PNG, React/TSX, or an artifact: real brand logos (svgl, devicon, official AWS / Google Cloud / Azure icons, Lucide pictograms), labeled group boxes, deterministic auto-layout with orthogonal arrows that never cross text, a machine-checked readability gate with fix hints, atomic delivery with a receipt, architecture delta between two versions, repository evidence per node, and first-class Korean typography (embedded Pretendard, Hangul width budgets).
